country.description: The two-character ISO 3166-1 code that identifies the country or region.

postalCode.description: The postal code, which is the zip code or equivalent.  Typically required for countries with a postal code or an equivalent.

countrySubdivision.description: The highest level sub-division in a country, which is usually a province, state, or ISO-3166-2 subdivision.

city.description: A city, town, or village. Smaller than admin_area_level_1

addressLine2.description: The second line of the address. For example, suite or apartment number.

addressLine1.description: The first line of the address. For example, number or street.  For example, 173 Drury Lane. Required for data entry and compliance and risk checks. Must contain the full address.
